CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners who are apprehending their arrest in Crime No.280/2023 registered by Yeswanthpura Police Station, Bengaluru City for the offences punishable Sections 420, 465, 468 471 of IPC are before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.,
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.280/2023 was registered by Yeswanthpura Police Station, Bengaluru City against the owner of the firm known as 'Sri Kukke Subramanyeshwara Traders', on the basis of first information dated 23.08.2023 received from Mohammed Afsal authorized representative of Bajaj Aliiance General Insurance Co. Ltd., Apprehending arrest in the said case, the petitioners had filed Crl.Misc.7356/2024 before the jurisdictional Sessions Court, which was rejected on 19.08.2024.

sentences.text: Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, the learned HCGP has opposed the bail application.

6. From a perusal of the first information dated 23.08.2023 which has resulted in registering FIR in Crime No.280/2023 by Yeswanthpura Police Station against the owner of the firm known as 'Sri Kukke Subramanyeshwara Traders' it is seen that, accident claim was made by 'Sri Kukke Subramanyeshwara Traders' with the complainant company in respect of a vehicle bearing reigsration No.NL-01-AE-3870 which stood in the name of the firm.
7. According to the first informant, the company had not issued the policy in respect of aforesaid vehicle and on the basis of a fraudulent insurance policy, the claim was made.
NC: 2024:KHC:37498 Notice has been issued to the petitioners during the course of investigation.
A perusal of said notice would go to show that the petitioners are employees working in the aforesaid firm known as 'Sri Kukke Subramanyeshwara Traders'.
The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment for a period of 7 years.

Considering the aforesaid aspect of the matter and also having regard to the fact that the petitioners do not have any criminal antecedents, I am of the opinion that the petitioners have made out a case for grant of anticipatory.

8. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER The Criminal Petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.280/2023 registered by Yeswanthpura Police Station, Bengaluru City for the offences punishable Sections 420, 465, 468 & 471 of IPC subject to the following conditions:
1.

The petitioners shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh NC: 2024:KHC:37498 only) each with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. The petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
3. The petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and they shall co-operate with the Police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.

4. The petitioners shall not involve in similar offences in future SD/-
